<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8"/>
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"/>
<title>Emeejay Assess</title>
<link rel="icon" type="image/png" href="data:image/png;base64,"/>
<link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="data:image/png;base64,"/>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@tabler/icons-webfont@latest/dist/tabler-icons.min.css"/>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com"/>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin/>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Andika:wght@400;700&display=swap"/>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Caveat:wght@700&display=swap"/>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2"></script>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="styles.css">
<script>
  window.va = window.va || function () { (window.vaq = window.vaq || []).push(arguments); };
</script>
<script defer src="/_vercel/insights/script.js"></script>
</head>
<body>
<div class="page">

<div id="entry-chooser-view" class="page-dark full-bleed">
  <div class="auth-wrap landing-wrap">
    <div class="chooser-decor">
      <div class="chooser-icon" style="background:var(--hp-purple);top:2%;left:4%;transform:rotate(-12deg);"><i class="ti ti-abc ico-phonics" aria-hidden="true"></i></div>
      <div class="chooser-icon small hide-mobile" style="background:#1E9E76;top:16%;left:0;transform:rotate(9deg);"><i class="ti ti-calculator ico-maths" aria-hidden="true"></i></div>
      <div class="chooser-icon" style="background:#3B5FCC;top:1%;right:5%;transform:rotate(10deg);"><i class="ti ti-book-2 ico-english" aria-hidden="true"></i></div>
      <div class="chooser-icon small hide-mobile" style="background:#C9750B;top:18%;right:0;transform:rotate(-8deg);"><i class="ti ti-world ico-topics" aria-hidden="true"></i></div>
      <div class="chooser-icon small" style="background:#3F8F1F;top:42%;left:2%;transform:rotate(-6deg);"><i class="ti ti-leaf ico-science" aria-hidden="true"></i></div>
      <div class="chooser-icon small" style="background:#C2255C;top:42%;right:2%;transform:rotate(7deg);"><i class="ti ti-star ico-re" aria-hidden="true"></i></div>
      <div class="chooser-icon hide-mobile" style="background:#C23B3B;bottom:14%;left:3%;transform:rotate(8deg);"><i class="ti ti-language ico-mfl" aria-hidden="true"></i></div>
      <div class="chooser-icon hide-mobile" style="background:#6B3FA0;bottom:14%;right:3%;transform:rotate(-9deg);"><i class="ti ti-music ico-music" aria-hidden="true"></i></div>
      <div class="chooser-icon small hide-mobile" style="background:#2E5DA8;bottom:0;left:14%;transform:rotate(-5deg);"><i class="ti ti-brain ico-reasoning" aria-hidden="true"></i></div>
      <div class="chooser-icon small hide-mobile" style="background:#35495E;bottom:0;right:14%;transform:rotate(6deg);"><i class="ti ti-device-desktop ico-computing" aria-hidden="true"></i></div>
      <div class="chooser-icon small hide-mobile" style="background:#8B5CF6;bottom:2%;left:38%;transform:rotate(4deg);"><i class="ti ti-building-carousel ico-early-years" aria-hidden="true"></i></div>

      <div class="chooser-card">
        <div class="brand-lockup">
          <svg class="brand-lockup-icon" aria-hidden="true" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 120 120" width="60" height="60" fill="none"><g transform="translate(0 11.5)" stroke="#C8A6FF" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M14 80 C24 52 40 26 50 34 C58 41 38 54 24 64 C12 73 22 87 42 87 C64 87 86 67 106 38"/><path d="M92.4 44.4 L106 38 L104.8 53"/></g></svg>
          <div class="brand-lockup-word">emeejay</div>
          <div class="brand-lockup-sub">All your assessments in one place</div>
        </div>

        <div class="landing-hero" style="padding:1.5rem 0 0.5rem;text-align:center;">
          <div class="hero-title" style="font-size:21px;">Who's this for?</div>
          <p class="hero-sub" style="max-width:380px;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto;">Choose an option to continue.</p>
          <div class="cta-row" style="max-width:360px;margin:1.25rem auto 0;">
            <button class="btn btn-ghost" onclick="chooseTeacherEntry()">I'm a teacher or school staff</button>
            <button class="btn btn-ghost" onclick="showPlayPortal()">I'm a student with a class code</button>
            <button class="btn btn-ghost" onclick="chooseTrustEntry()">I'm a trust, MAT or company</button>
            <button class="btn btn-ghost" onclick="chooseParentEntry()">I'm a parent/carer with a code</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div id="landing-view" class="page-dark" style="display:none;">
  <div class="auth-wrap landing-wrap">
    <div class="chooser-decor">
    <div class="chooser-decor-icons" data-decor-size="full"></div>
    <div class="brand-lockup">
      <a href="javascript:void(0)" onclick="goToAuth('signin')" class="brand-lockup-corner">Sign in</a>
      <svg class="brand-lockup-icon" aria-hidden="true" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 120 120" width="60" height="60" fill="none"><g transform="translate(0 11.5)" stroke="#C8A6FF" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M14 80 C24 52 40 26 50 34 C58 41 38 54 24 64 C12 73 22 87 42 87 C64 87 86 67 106 38"/><path d="M92.4 44.4 L106 38 L104.8 53"/></g></svg>
      <div class="brand-lockup-word">emeejay</div>
      <div class="brand-lockup-sub">All your assessments in one place</div>
    </div>

    <div class="landing-hero" style="padding:1.25rem 0 0.25rem;">
      <div class="hero-title">Time to teach.</div>
      <p class="hero-sub">Emeejay Assess takes you the whole way: quick, simple checks feed live results and analysis as they come in, gaps and most-missed questions are surfaced automatically, and from there you can set targets and generate parent/carer-ready progress reports for a child, a class or the whole year &ndash; all in a click. It's light enough to fit around the school day, valuable enough to matter in pupil progress meetings, and thorough enough to show ISI and Ofsted real evidence of children's progress.</p>

      <div class="cta-row" style="max-width:340px;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto;">
        <button class="btn btn-primary" style="padding:1rem;font-size:18px;font-weight:700;" onclick="viewDemo(this)">Try Now</button>
        <div style="text-align:center;margin:0.4rem 0 0.1rem;font-size:13px;color:var(--text-muted);">Demo code: <span style="font-family:'SFMono-Regular',Consolas,monospace;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:0.5px;color:#C8A6FF;">DEMOLITION5678</span></div>
        <button class="btn btn-ghost" onclick="goToAuth('signup','create')">Start your free 14-day trial</button>
      </div>
      <a href="javascript:void(0)" class="mini-link" onclick="goToAuth('signin')">Already have an account? Sign in</a>
      <a href="javascript:void(0)" class="mini-link" onclick="goToChooser()">Not school staff? Go back</a>

      <div class="landing-stat-row">
        <div class="landing-stat"><div class="landing-stat-val">12</div><div class="landing-stat-lbl">subjects covered</div></div>
        <div class="landing-stat"><div class="landing-stat-val">&pound;200</div><div class="landing-stat-lbl">per year, per school</div></div>
        <div class="landing-stat"><div class="landing-stat-val">14</div><div class="landing-stat-lbl">day free trial</div></div>
      </div>

      <div class="subject-chip-row">
        <span class="subject-chip" style="background:var(--hp-purple);"><i class="ti ti-abc ico-phonics" aria-hidden="true"></i>Phonics</span>
        <span class="subject-chip" style="background:#1E9E76;"><i class="ti ti-calculator ico-maths" aria-hidden="true"></i>Maths</span>
        <span class="subject-chip" style="background:#3B5FCC;"><i class="ti ti-book-2 ico-english" aria-hidden="true"></i>English</span>
        <span class="subject-chip" style="background:#C9750B;"><i class="ti ti-world ico-topics" aria-hidden="true"></i>Topics</span>
        <span class="subject-chip" style="background:#3F8F1F;"><i class="ti ti-leaf ico-science" aria-hidden="true"></i>Science</span>
        <span class="subject-chip" style="background:#C2255C;"><i class="ti ti-star ico-re" aria-hidden="true"></i>RE</span>
        <span class="subject-chip" style="background:#C23B3B;"><i class="ti ti-language ico-mfl" aria-hidden="true"></i>Languages</span>
        <span c
